values.note: ReserveAmerica sells 39 campsites (18 Campsite Electric in Loops D, E and the Pullouts; 21 Campsite in Loops A-C and the Pullouts) besides a group camp, hike/bike site, wall tent and 3 cabins; FWP says '40 campsites'. Max vehicle lengths 31-52 ft back-in; the 7 Pullouts sites are pull-through, 45-50 ft electric and 71 ft non-electric.

values.note: $5 charge to use the dump station. Water is off October 1 - April 30, so flush toilets, showers, drinking water and the dump station are seasonal (FWP: water and showers 'May through September as weather allows').

note: MT State Park SW of Whitehall. Campground of interior loops A-E plus outer pull-throughs in open juniper hills above the Jefferson River valley, long level gravel pads; also 3 cabins and a wall tent. --Claude
